Title: Cortisol Belly: What's Real vs. Overhyped

Description:
Cortisol dysregulation can contribute to abdominal fat storage — visceral fat carries a high density of cortisol-activating receptors, so that part checks out. But "cortisol face" isn't a recognized diagnosis. What actually raises cortisol: stacking hard workouts without recovery days, an inconsistent sleep schedule, and chasing trendy fixes over stress techniques with real trial data (like mindfulness-based programs) behind them.

If you're seeing rapid weight gain with muscle weakness or new purple stretch marks, that points to Cushing's syndrome — get an actual cortisol test from a doctor.
